# XCONDA

> XCONDA (엑스콘다) is an AI video and storyboard production studio by Cubeberry Co., Ltd. It splits a scenario into shots, previews each shot as an image, and generates video with models such as Seedance 2.5, Kling and Veo. Korean and English interfaces are served on separate URLs.

## Product

- [Features overview](https://www.xconda.ai/features): one page per tool — storyboard, blocking, 360 set, image, video, upscaling and more.
- [FLEXBOARD](https://www.xconda.ai/features/flexboard): shot-by-shot AI storyboard; fix only the shots you dislike before rendering.
- [Blocking Board](https://www.xconda.ai/features/blocking-board): digital rehearsal for camera, blocking and collisions.
- [360 Turn Studio](https://www.xconda.ai/features/turn): build an orbitable 360° set from one photo.
- [AI video generation](https://www.xconda.ai/features/video): text, image, start/end frames and references; Seedance 2.5 up to 30 seconds with audio.
- [AI image generation](https://www.xconda.ai/features/image): Grok Imagine, Seedream Lite, Z Image, Nano Banana Pro in one workspace.
- [Pricing](https://www.xconda.ai/pricing): one-time credit packs (2,020 to 114,000 credits), valid one year.
- [Korean site](https://www.xconda.ai/ko): same product, Korean copy.

## Support and policy

- [Terms](https://www.xconda.ai/legal/terms) · [Privacy](https://www.xconda.ai/legal/privacy) · [Refund](https://www.xconda.ai/legal/refund)
- [Q&A on the hub](https://hub.xconda.ai/qna/): Korean answers about pricing, credits, refunds, copyright and privacy.
- [English Q&A](https://hub.xconda.ai/en/qna/): reviewed English answers to the same questions.

## Notes

- Prices are stated in USD on the English site; Korean billing includes 10% VAT and is charged in KRW.
- Tool screens at /studio/* require sign-in. The /features/* pages describe the same tools and are public.
